name: dsh-conv-export
description: dsh-conv-export（对话导出）— export the current conversation as Markdown, single-file HTML, PDF, or a long PNG image, or copy it as Markdown; batch-export historical sessions as a Markdown ZIP.
author: beijingwahw

privacy.note: 批量导出仅在宿主内读取会话并打包为 ZIP 供下载，不经任何第三方服务；无存储域、无出站网络请求、无追踪代码。
